school.name: Agaro High School
school.motto: Excellence in Learning, Character in Action
school.description: Agaro High School is a leading educational institution serving the community with intellectual rigour, academic distinction, and strong moral values.
school.mission: To provide quality education that builds intellectual ability, leadership, discipline, and service to the community.
school.vision: To be a model secondary school known for academic excellence, innovation, and positive community impact.
school.history: Established in 1954, Agaro High School has grown into a respected institution that continues to shape confident, capable, and responsible young leaders.

footer.tagline: Serving the community with intellectual rigour and academic distinction since 1954.

hero.headline: Shaping Future Leaders Through Knowledge and Character
hero.subheadline: Agaro High School nurtures academic excellence, leadership, creativity, and community engagement for the next generation.

about.overview: Agaro High School is committed to creating a nurturing and intellectually rigorous environment where students can discover their talents and pursue excellence.
about.mission: To provide quality education that develops intellectual curiosity, responsible citizenship, and strong leadership.
about.vision: To be a center of excellence in education recognized for academic achievement, innovation, and service to society.

programs.title: Natural Sciences
programs.description: A rigorous pathway focused on biology, chemistry, physics, and mathematics.

programs.title: Social Sciences
programs.description: Designed for students interested in economics, geography, civics, and social development.

programs.title: General Education
programs.description: A balanced curriculum combining core academic subjects with practical and creative learning.

clubs.name: Science Club
clubs.description: Encourages curiosity, experimentation, and participation in science fairs.

clubs.name: Debate Club
clubs.description: Builds confidence in speaking, reasoning, and public presentation.

clubs.name: Sports Club
clubs.description: Promotes teamwork, fitness, and school spirit through various games.

clubs.name: Arts & Culture
clubs.description: Celebrates creativity through music, drama, dance, and visual art.

events.title: Science and Innovation Week
events.description: Students present projects, experiments, and innovative ideas to the school community.

events.title: School Leadership Forum
events.description: Student leaders discuss teamwork, governance, responsibility, and engagement.

events.title: Inter-School Football Tournament
events.description: A competitive sports event promoting health, teamwork, and school spirit.

news.title: New Library Resource Center Opens
news.summary: Students now have access to expanded reading rooms, digital resources, and study spaces for independent learning.
news.content: The new resource center was opened to improve access to digital learning materials and provide students with a dedicated environment for reading and research.

news.title: Admissions for 2026/27 Open
news.summary: Applications are currently being accepted for Grade 9 and transfer students from qualified applicants.
news.content: Parents and guardians are encouraged to submit their applications early as spaces are limited and the admissions process is open for the new academic year.

news.title: School Performance Highlights
news.summary: Agaro High School recorded strong results in national assessments and science competitions.
news.content: Students demonstrated excellent dedication and performance across multiple academic disciplines, reflecting the school’s commitment to excellence.

testimonials.name: Abel M.
testimonials.quote: Agaro High School helped me build confidence, discipline, and the skills I need to pursue my future goals.

testimonials.name: Netsanet T.
testimonials.quote: The school cares deeply about student growth, both academically and personally. We are proud to be part of this community.

testimonials.name: Daniel K.
testimonials.quote: The teaching quality and strong values I gained here prepared me well for university and life beyond school.
